These issues are not isolated mistakes. They stem from workflows that execute untrusted pull request content in privileged contexts, creating severe supply chain risk. In a separate blog, we explained how we built an AI agent to systematically detect these misconfiguration patterns at scale, what signals it looks for, and how such vulnerabilities can escalate from a single repository to organization-wide compromise. 把所有无证据、弱证据和推断点显式标记，等待补证后再升级结论。

只能证明技术存在，无法证明需求、成本、规则或影响。
所有高价值信息都来自营销页或无法复查的截图。
